across.en: spread over a number of things

age.en: coming of age: becoming fully developed
age.ex: The band's new album marks its coming of age.

agency.en: a government organisation with a special job
agency.ex: The space agency launched a new satellite.

ahead.ex: We arrived ahead of the other guests.

ai.en: computers that can think and learn like people
ai.ex: Many phones now use AI to improve photos.

almost.ex: It is almost time for dinner.

also.ex: She speaks French and also some German.

approximately.en: close to a number, but not exact
approximately.ex: The flight takes approximately three hours.

artificial.ex: The park has an artificial lake.

as.en: in the role or way of

attributing.en: saying something is caused by something else
attributing.ex: Doctors attribute her recovery to early treatment.

example.en: She attributes her good health to daily walks.
example.zh: 她把自己的好身體歸功於每天散步。

note.meaning: 把（某結果）歸因於某原因；認為…是由…造成。
note.usage: 常用 attribute A to B，表示「把 A 歸因於 B」；被動 be attributed to 也很常見。

noteEn.meaning: to say that something is caused by a particular thing.
noteEn.usage: Use 'attribute A to B'; the passive 'be attributed to' is very common.

noteEs.exampleTr: Ella atribuye su buena salud a sus paseos diarios.
noteEs.meaning: atribuir un resultado a una causa.
noteEs.usage: Se usa attribute A to B; también en pasiva: be attributed to.

noteHi.exampleTr: वह अपने अच्छे स्वास्थ्य का श्रेय रोज़ की सैर को देती है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी परिणाम का कारण किसी चीज़ को मानना।
noteHi.usage: attribute A to B = A का कारण B को मानना; be attributed to भी आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼女は健康の秘訣を毎日の散歩だと考えている。
noteJa.meaning: ある結果を何かが原因だと考える。
noteJa.usage: attribute A to B で「AをBのせいにする／Bに帰する」。受動態 be attributed to も多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그녀는 자신의 건강을 매일 하는 산책 덕분으로 여긴다.
noteKo.usage: attribute A to B: A를 B의 덕분/탓으로 돌리다. 수동태 be attributed to도 자주 쓰인다.

automates.en: makes a process work by machine or computer
automates.ex: The bank automates most of its payments.

back.en: going back to normal: returning to usual
back.ex: Life slowly went back to normal after the storm.

backer.en: a person or group that gives money or support
backer.ex: The film found a wealthy backer in Hollywood.

been.zh: 是（have been 的過去分詞）

beginning.ex: We met at the beginning of the year.

big.ex: Missing the bus was not a big deal.

biggest.ex: This is the biggest city in the country.

bumper.ex: Farmers enjoyed a bumper harvest this autumn.

but.en: used to add a different idea

came.en: came out: was made public; came from: was received from
came.ex: The new phone came out last week.

cameramatics.en: an Irish vehicle safety software company
cameramatics.ja: カメラマティクス（企業名）

capital.en: money used to start or grow a business
capital.ex: The company needs more capital to expand.

characterised.en: described something as having a certain quality
characterised.ex: Critics characterised the film as slow but beautiful.

chief.ex: She is the chief engineer on the project.

close.ex: Close to a thousand people came to the concert.

coming.en: coming of age: reaching full development
coming.ex: The festival celebrates the coming of spring.

companies.en: businesses that make or sell things
companies.ex: Many companies let staff work from home.

company.ex: My brother works for a small company.

compliance.ex: The firm checks compliance with safety rules every month.
compliance.ja: 法令遵守；コンプライアンス

conducted.ex: The survey was conducted by phone.

contraction.en: a reduction in size or amount
contraction.ex: The economy suffered a sharp contraction last year.

example.en: The housing market saw a contraction in sales.
example.zh: 房市的銷售量出現萎縮。

note.meaning: （規模、數量或經濟活動的）萎縮、縮減。
note.usage: 常用於經濟、市場語境，如 economic contraction；反義為 expansion。

noteEn.meaning: a fall in size, amount or economic activity.
noteEn.usage: Often used about economies and markets; the opposite is 'expansion'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El mercado inmobiliario registró una contracción en las ventas.
noteEs.meaning: reducción de tamaño, cantidad o actividad económica.
noteEs.usage: Común en economía: economic contraction; lo opuesto es expansion.

noteHi.exampleTr: आवास बाज़ार की बिक्री में गिरावट देखी गई।
noteHi.meaning: आकार या मात्रा में कमी; संकुचन।
noteHi.usage: अर्थव्यवस्था और बाज़ार के लिए प्रयोग, जैसे economic contraction; विपरीत expansion।

noteJa.exampleTr: 住宅市場では販売が縮小した。
noteJa.meaning: 規模・量・経済活動の縮小。
noteJa.usage: 経済や市場の文脈で多用（economic contraction）。反意語は expansion。

noteKo.usage: 경제·시장 맥락에서 자주 쓰임(economic contraction). 반대말은 expansion.

cooling.en: cooling off: becoming less active or strong
cooling.ex: House prices are cooling after a busy year.

data.en: facts and numbers collected for study
data.ex: The app collects data about your sleep.

date.ex: To date, nobody has solved the puzzle.

deal.en: a business agreement, here an investment
deal.ex: The two firms signed a deal on Monday.

deals.ex: The shop offers great deals on shoes.

decline.en: a fall in amount or value
decline.ex: There has been a decline in bird numbers.

declined.en: went down in amount or value
declined.ex: Sales declined sharply in the winter.

decrease.en: a fall in amount or number
decrease.ex: We saw a decrease in traffic on Sunday.

described.ex: He described the hotel as quiet and clean.

develops.en: creates and builds a new product
develops.ex: Her team develops games for children.

downturn.en: a fall in business or economic activity
downturn.ex: Many shops closed during the economic downturn.

dropped.en: became lower in amount or value
dropped.ex: The temperature dropped quickly at night.

enterprise.en: part of Enterprise Ireland, a state business agency
enterprise.ja: エンタープライズ・アイルランド（政府機関）

enterprises.ex: Small enterprises create many local jobs.

equilibrium.en: a state of balance where things stay steady
equilibrium.ex: Prices rose until supply and demand reached equilibrium.

example.en: After the crisis, the market slowly returned to equilibrium.
example.zh: 危機過後，市場慢慢恢復了平衡。

note.meaning: 平衡、均衡狀態；各種力量相互抵消而保持穩定。
note.usage: 常見於經濟與科學語境，如 return to / reach equilibrium；也可指心理上的平靜。

noteEn.meaning: a state of balance where things stay stable.
noteEn.usage: Common in economics and science: 'reach' or 'return to equilibrium'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Tras la crisis, el mercado volvió poco a poco al equilibrio.
noteEs.meaning: estado de equilibrio en el que todo se mantiene estable.
noteEs.usage: Común en economía y ciencia: reach / return to equilibrium.

noteHi.exampleTr: संकट के बाद बाज़ार धीरे-धीरे संतुलन में लौट आया।
noteHi.meaning: संतुलन की स्थिति, जिसमें चीज़ें स्थिर रहती हैं।
noteHi.usage: अर्थशास्त्र और विज्ञान में आम: reach / return to equilibrium।

noteJa.exampleTr: 危機の後、市場はゆっくりと均衡を取り戻した。
noteJa.meaning: 釣り合いが取れて安定している状態。
noteJa.usage: 経済や科学の文脈で多用：reach / return to equilibrium。心の平静の意味もある。

noteKo.exampleTr: 위기 이후 시장은 서서히 균형을 되찾았다.
noteKo.meaning: 힘이 서로 맞서 안정을 유지하는 균형 상태.
noteKo.usage: 경제·과학에서 자주 쓰임: reach / return to equilibrium. 마음의 평정을 뜻하기도 한다.

evidence.en: something that shows a thing is true
evidence.ex: The new jobs are evidence that the town is growing.

example.en: Rising sales are clear evidence of strong demand.
example.zh: 銷售上升是需求強勁的明確證據。

note.meaning: 證據；能證明某事為真的跡象或事實。
note.usage: 不可數名詞，不說 an evidence；常用 evidence of / that…，或 a piece of evidence。

noteEn.meaning: facts or signs that show something is true.
noteEn.usage: Uncountable: say 'evidence of' or 'a piece of evidence', not 'an evidence'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El aumento de las ventas es una clara prueba de una fuerte demanda.
noteEs.meaning: prueba; algo que demuestra que algo es cierto.
noteEs.usage: Sustantivo incontable (no 'an evidence'); se usa evidence of / that…

noteHi.exampleTr: बढ़ती बिक्री मज़बूत मांग का स्पष्ट सबूत है।
noteHi.meaning: सबूत; कोई बात सच होने का प्रमाण।
noteHi.usage: अगणनीय संज्ञा (an evidence नहीं); evidence of / that… का प्रयोग होता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 売上の増加は需要が強いことの明らかな証拠だ。
noteJa.meaning: 何かが本当であることを示す証拠・しるし。
noteJa.usage: 不可算名詞（an evidence とは言わない）。evidence of / that… の形で使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 판매 증가는 강한 수요의 분명한 증거이다.
noteKo.meaning: 어떤 것이 사실임을 보여 주는 증거.
noteKo.usage: 셀 수 없는 명사(an evidence 불가). evidence of / that… 형태로 쓴다.

exceeds.ex: The cost exceeds our budget by a lot.

exceptional.ex: She showed exceptional talent at a young age.

executive.en: a senior manager in a company
executive.ex: The executive announced new plans for the firm.

falls.en: falls short of: is less than
falls.ex: His score falls short of the top mark.

far.ex: So far, the weather has been perfect.

figure.ex: The official figure shows rising unemployment.

findings.ex: The findings will be shared next month.

firm.ex: She joined a law firm in London.

firms.ex: Tech firms are hiring more engineers.

fleet.en: a group of vehicles owned by one company
fleet.ex: The taxi company has a fleet of electric cars.

flowed.en: moved steadily into a place, here money
flowed.ex: Donations flowed in after the flood.

fonoa.en: a company that makes tax software

fundamental.ex: There is a fundamental flaw in the plan.

funding.ex: The school lost its government funding.

generated.ex: The festival generated a lot of income for the town.

example.en: The new mall will generate hundreds of jobs.
example.zh: 新購物中心將創造數百個工作機會。

note.meaning: 產生；創造（收入、資金、能量等）。
note.usage: 常用於 generate revenue/income/interest，指帶來或產出某物。

noteEn.meaning: to produce or create something, such as money or energy.
noteEn.usage: Often used with revenue, income, jobs or interest.

noteEs.exampleTr: El nuevo centro comercial generará cientos de empleos.

noteHi.exampleTr: नया मॉल सैकड़ों नौकरियाँ पैदा करेगा।
noteHi.meaning: उत्पन्न करना; पैदा करना (आय, धन आदि)।
noteHi.usage: generate revenue/income/interest जैसे वाक्यांशों में आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しいショッピングモールは何百もの雇用を生み出すだろう。
noteJa.meaning: （収入・資金・エネルギーなどを）生み出す。
noteJa.usage: generate revenue/income/interest の形でよく使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 새 쇼핑몰은 수백 개의 일자리를 창출할 것이다.

going.ex: We are going home after dinner.

growing.ex: There is growing interest in electric cars.

had.en: possessed; was involved (had a hand in)
had.ex: She had a key role in the project.

hand.en: a part or role in something
hand.ex: He had a hand in planning the party.
hand.zh: 手（have a hand in：參與其中）

haul.ex: The team returned with a record haul of medals.

helps.ex: This app helps people learn languages.

higher.ex: Prices are higher in the city.

homegrown.en: from your own country or area
homegrown.ex: The club relies on homegrown players.

include.en: have as part of a group

increasing.ex: There is increasing demand for clean energy.

intelligence.ex: Dolphins are known for their intelligence.

international.ex: She works for an international charity.

interpreted.ex: He interpreted her silence as agreement.

invested.en: put money in to earn more
invested.ex: They invested their savings in property.

investments.ex: Her investments grew steadily over ten years.

investors.en: people who put money into businesses
investors.ex: Investors are worried about rising interest rates.

involved.ex: Many parents are involved in the school.

just.ex: I just want a glass of water.

keep.en: make something stay in a state

largest.ex: This is the largest city in the country.

likewise.ex: She left early, and likewise her brother.

makes.ex: The company makes software for schools.

management.ex: Good time management is important for students.

market.ex: The housing market slowed down this year.

example.en: The startup scene is showing signs of maturity.
example.zh: 新創圈正展現出成熟的跡象。

note.usage: 可指人或產業、市場的成熟，常與 reach/show/growing 搭配。

noteEn.meaning: the state of being fully grown or developed.
noteEn.usage: Used for people, industries or markets; 'reach maturity'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El ecosistema de startups muestra signos de madurez.
noteEs.usage: Para personas, industrias o mercados; con reach/show/growing.

noteHi.exampleTr: स्टार्टअप जगत परिपक्वता के संकेत दिखा रहा है।
noteHi.usage: व्यक्ति, उद्योग या बाज़ार के लिए; reach/show maturity के साथ।

noteJa.exampleTr: スタートアップ業界は成熟の兆しを見せている。
noteJa.meaning: 成熟；十分に発達した状態。
noteJa.usage: 人にも産業・市場にも使う。reach/show maturity など。

noteKo.exampleTr: 스타트업 업계가 성숙의 조짐을 보이고 있다.
noteKo.usage: 사람, 산업, 시장에 쓰이며 reach/show maturity 등과 함께 쓴다.

median.en: the middle value in a set
median.ex: The median income rose last year.

meeting.en: an event where people gather to talk

money.en: what you use to buy things
money.ex: They saved money for a new car.

more.ex: Deals worth more than ten million are rare.

most.ex: This is the most popular dish here.

nevertheless.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.

normal.ex: Life returned to normal after the storm.

normalisation.ex: Economists expect a normalisation of prices next year.

noted.ex: The teacher noted that attendance had improved.

observed.ex: She observed that the room was very quiet.

off.ex: Let the soup cool off before eating.

out.ex: Her new book came out last month.

example.en: Online sales now outstrip store sales.
example.zh: 線上銷售現在已超過實體店銷售。

note.usage: 及物動詞，常用於 demand outstrips supply，比較數量或成長。

noteEn.meaning: to be bigger, faster or more than something else.
noteEn.usage: Takes a direct object: 'demand outstrips supply'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las ventas en línea ya superan a las de las tiendas.
noteEs.usage: Verbo transitivo; común en demand outstrips supply.

noteHi.exampleTr: ऑनलाइन बिक्री अब दुकानों की बिक्री से आगे निकल गई है।
noteHi.usage: सकर्मक क्रिया; demand outstrips supply में आम।

noteJa.exampleTr: 今やオンライン販売は店舗販売を上回っている。
noteJa.meaning: （量・速度などで）上回る；しのぐ。
noteJa.usage: 他動詞。demand outstrips supply（需要が供給を上回る）が典型。

noteKo.exampleTr: 이제 온라인 판매가 매장 판매를 앞지른다.
noteKo.usage: 타동사. demand outstrips supply(수요가 공급을 앞지르다)가 대표적.

part.ex: Many students took part in the race.

participated.ex: Over 200 runners participated in the event.

example.en: All staff are invited to participate in the survey.
example.zh: 所有員工都受邀參加這項調查。

note.usage: 後接 in：participate in sth，比 take part in 更正式。

noteEn.meaning: to take part in an activity or event.
noteEn.usage: Use 'participate in'; more formal than 'take part in'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Se invita a todo el personal a participar en la encuesta.
noteEs.usage: Se usa con in: participate in algo; más formal que take part in.

noteHi.exampleTr: सभी कर्मचारियों को सर्वेक्षण में भाग लेने के लिए आमंत्रित किया गया है।
noteHi.usage: participate in के साथ; take part in से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 全職員がアンケートへの参加を呼びかけられている。
noteJa.usage: participate in 〜 の形。take part in より改まった表現。

noteKo.exampleTr: 모든 직원이 설문 조사에 참여하도록 초대되었다.
noteKo.usage: participate in ~ 형태로 쓰며 take part in보다 격식적이다.

period.ex: It was a difficult period for the family.

preceding.ex: Sales rose compared to the preceding month.

previous.ex: I met him on a previous visit.

prior.ex: Please arrive prior to the start time.

problem.ex: Traffic is a big problem here.

process.en: a series of changes over time
process.ex: Learning a language is a slow process.

provider.ex: Our internet provider raised its prices.
provider.zh: 提供者（data provider：數據供應商）

raised.ex: The charity raised ten thousand dollars.

rather.ex: I'd walk rather than take the bus.

rds.en: a large event venue in Dublin
rds.zh: RDS（都柏林皇家都柏林學會展館）

reflecting.en: showing or being a sign of

regards.en: thinks of something in a certain way
regards.ex: Many people regard him as a hero.

released.ex: The band released a new album last week.

remains.ex: The shop remains open until nine.

report.en: written document giving facts and results
report.ex: The report shows sales went up.

represents.ex: This result represents a big improvement.

research.en: careful study to find new facts
research.ex: Her research focuses on climate change.

return.en: going back to an earlier state
return.ex: Fans celebrated the player's return to the team.

reveals.en: shows something that was not known
reveals.ex: The survey reveals that most people sleep too little.

rounds.en: stages of raising money from investors
rounds.ex: The startup completed two funding rounds this year.

run-up.en: the period just before an event
run-up.ex: Prices rose in the run-up to the holidays.

safe.ex: Keep your passport in a safe place.

safety.ex: Wear a helmet for your safety.

said.ex: She said the meeting was cancelled.

saying.ex: He left, saying he was tired.

says.ex: The sign says the park closes at six.

sector's.en: belonging to a part of the economy
sector's.ex: The tech sector's growth is fast.

secured.ex: The team secured a place in the final.

settling.ex: The weather is settling after the storm.

several.en: more than two but not many

short.ex: The team fell short of its goal.

significant.ex: There was a significant rise in prices.

similarly.ex: Similarly, the second test was easy.

size.ex: The size of the room surprised us.

so.en: used in 'so far' meaning until now
so.ex: So far, everything is going well.

software.ex: I need new software for editing photos.

specialist.en: a person or company expert in one area
specialist.ex: She is a specialist in heart disease.

stabilising.en: becoming steady and not changing much
stabilising.ex: House prices are stabilising this year.

standout.en: much better or bigger than others
standout.ex: She was the standout player of the match.

start.ex: We were nervous at the start of the exam.

state.ex: She studied at a state school.

still.ex: It was late, but he was still working.

strong.ex: The company had a strong year.

substantial.ex: She received a substantial pay rise.

example.en: The new road made a substantial difference to traffic.
example.zh: 新道路使交通有了顯著的改善。

note.meaning: 數量、程度或價值上相當大的；可觀的。
note.usage: 常修飾 increase、decrease、amount、sum 等名詞，比 big 更正式。

noteEn.meaning: large in amount, size or importance.
noteEn.usage: Often used with increase, amount or sum; more formal than 'big'.

noteEs.exampleTr: La nueva carretera supuso una diferencia considerable en el tráfico.
noteEs.meaning: grande o importante en cantidad o valor.
noteEs.usage: Acompaña a increase, amount, sum; más formal que 'big'.

noteHi.exampleTr: नई सड़क से यातायात में काफ़ी बड़ा फ़र्क पड़ा।
noteHi.meaning: मात्रा या महत्व में काफ़ी बड़ा।
noteHi.usage: increase, amount, sum जैसे शब्दों के साथ; 'big' से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい道路は交通に大きな違いをもたらした。
noteJa.meaning: 量・程度・価値がかなり大きい。
noteJa.usage: increase, amount, sum などと共に使い、big より改まった語。

noteKo.exampleTr: 새 도로는 교통에 상당한 변화를 가져왔다.
noteKo.usage: increase, amount, sum 등과 함께 쓰며 big보다 격식 있는 말.

sum.ex: They paid a large sum for the house.

summit.en: an important meeting of leaders or experts
summit.ex: World leaders met at the climate summit.

example.en: The film surpassed all previous box-office records.
example.zh: 這部電影打破了以往所有的票房紀錄。

note.meaning: 超過、超越（某數量、標準或他人）。
note.usage: 及物動詞，直接接受詞，如 surpass expectations / a record；比 exceed 更強調「勝過」。

noteEn.meaning: to go above or be better than something.
noteEn.usage: Takes a direct object: surpass expectations, surpass a record.

noteEs.exampleTr: La película superó todos los récords de taquilla anteriores.
noteEs.meaning: superar o sobrepasar una cantidad, un nivel o a alguien.
noteEs.usage: Verbo transitivo: surpass expectations / a record.

noteHi.exampleTr: इस फ़िल्म ने पिछले सभी बॉक्स-ऑफ़िस रिकॉर्ड पार कर दिए।
noteHi.meaning: किसी संख्या, स्तर या व्यक्ति से आगे निकलना।
noteHi.usage: सीधे कर्म के साथ: surpass expectations / a record।

noteJa.exampleTr: その映画は過去の興行記録をすべて上回った。
noteJa.meaning: （数量・基準・他者を）上回る、しのぐ。
noteJa.usage: 他動詞で目的語を直接とる：surpass expectations / a record。

paragraphs: Irish companies that work with artificial intelligence (AI) got €256 million from investors this year. The money came from 75 deals.
This is less than last year. In 2025, the companies got €691.3 million. That was a very good year, the best ever.

Experts say this is not a big problem. The market is just going back to normal. This year, the biggest deals went to Fonoa and CameraMatics. Fonoa makes tax software. CameraMatics helps companies keep their vehicles safe.
Enterprise Ireland, a government agency, helped with about two out of three deals. Its boss, Jenny Melia, says Irish AI companies got nearly €1 billion since the start of 2025.
Irish companies that work with artificial intelligence (AI) have raised €256 million from investors so far this year. The money came from 75 deals, says a report by the research company PitchBook.

This is less than in 2025, which was a record year. Then, Irish AI firms raised €691.3 million in 107 deals. The typical size of a deal also fell, from €2.4 million to €1.6 million. But that is still higher than in any year before 2025.

PitchBook says this is not a big problem. The market is just going back to normal after a very strong year. In 2026, the biggest deals so far went to Fonoa, which makes tax software, and CameraMatics, which helps companies keep their vehicles safe.

The state agency Enterprise Ireland took part in almost two-thirds of this year's deals. Its chief executive, Jenny Melia, says Irish AI companies have raised nearly €1 billion since the start of 2025. The report came out before an international AI meeting in Dublin on 14 October.
Irish artificial intelligence (AI) companies have raised €256 million across 75 venture capital deals so far in 2026, according to research by the data firm PitchBook.

The figure is well below last year's record of €691.3 million from 107 deals. The median deal value has also dropped, from €2.4 million in 2025 to €1.6 million, although it remains higher than in any year before 2025.

PitchBook described the decline as normalisation rather than retreat, saying the market is settling after an exceptional year in which several deals were worth more than €100 million. This year's largest deals so far include €94.1 million for Fonoa, which automates tax compliance, and €49 million for CameraMatics, which provides vehicle safety and fleet management software.

Enterprise Ireland, which has taken part in 392 Irish AI funding rounds since 2020, was involved in nearly two-thirds of this year's deals. Its chief executive, Jenny Melia, said almost €1 billion has been raised by Irish AI firms since the start of 2025, reflecting their growing maturity. The research was released ahead of an international AI summit at the RDS in Dublin on 14 October.
